Same Wi-Fi · Android Chrome · No computer needed

Dad starts Zelda on his phone. JJ joins on the tablet, and Michelle joins on her phone using the same pairing code. Everyone watches the shared tablet.

The game loads automatically. Internet is needed to open the game and pair through PeerJS. Play travels directly between your devices, and your saves stay on your phone. Keep both tabs open and the phone unlocked.

Fairy sparks help with ordinary enemies. Bosses and special enemies still need Dad's skills. This is an unofficial family project using EmulatorJS and PeerJS.

Install the Android tablet appBlocks Back while locked. Accept Android's pinning prompt to block Home and Recents. Android 8 or newer.

Keep JJ in the game

For no address bar, use Chrome's menu > Add to Home screen > Install, then open the Fairy Link icon. After joining, turn sound on and tap Kid lock.

For Android navigation buttons, search tablet Settings for App pinning (or Pin app). Enable it with a PIN to unpin, then pin Fairy Link from the Recent apps screen. A browser tab alone cannot lock Android's buttons.

Hold the unlock button for 3 seconds, or use Dad's More > Unlock JJ's tablet.

Both devices should be on the same Wi-Fi.
